action.description: Invalid or missing "action" parameter. Must be one of: "build", "create", "list", "cancel". Example: { "action": "list", "chain": 1, "listMode": "by_maker", "makerAddress": "0x..." }

chain.description: Chain ID (number, e.g. 1 for Ethereum). Required for every action.

cursor.description: list: pagination cursor from a previous response.

execute.description: Optional. When a WalletConnect session is active, defaults to true: sign typedData and submit the order via the wallet (user confirms prompts). Set execute=false to return typed data for signing elsewhere. Set execute=true to require WalletConnect (errors if not connected).

expirationSeconds.description: build: optional order expiration in seconds from now (default 604800 = 7 days).

listMode.description: list: required. by_maker (needs makerAddress), by_hash (needs orderHash), or all.

makerAddress.description: Maker wallet address (0x + 40 hex). build: required (the address that signs). list by_maker: required.

makerAsset.description: build: required — maker asset token address (0x...) or symbol (e.g. USDC). list: optional address filter.

makingAmount.description: build: required — amount of maker asset to sell in smallest units (e.g. 1000000 for 1 USDC), as a string to avoid precision loss.

order.description: create (legacy): full signed order payload. Prefer orderHash + signature + orderData after build.

data.description: Limit order fields: makerAsset, takerAsset, maker, makingAmount, takingAmount, salt, extension, makerTraits, etc.

orderHash.description: Hash of the limit order typed data (EIP-712)

orderData.description: create: the orderData object from the build response.

orderHash.description: 0x-prefixed order hash. create: from the build response. list by_hash and cancel: required.

signature.description: create: EIP-712 signature from signing the typedData returned by build.

sortBy.description: list: sort field for endpoints that support it.

statuses.description: list: comma-separated status filters (e.g. 1 = active). See Orderbook API docs.

takerAsset.description: build: required — taker asset token address (0x...) or symbol (e.g. USDT). list: optional address filter.

takingAmount.description: build: required — amount of taker asset to receive in smallest units, as a string to avoid precision loss.

name: orderbook
